text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Government starts supplying northern provinces of Arbil and Dohuk with flour.
- Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein chairs cabinet meeting.
- Iraq and Greece start trade talks.
- Russia expresses readiness to cooperate with Iraq.
- Trade Ministry sells flour and rice at reduced prices in its shopping centres.
- Iraqi oil delegation leaves for Italy.
- Malaysian foreign minister ends visit to Baghdad.
(The above were also carried by Thawra and Jumhouriya)
- Washington gives in to Iraqi helicopter flights and stops its nervous statements.
- Preparations to receive Iraqi pilgrims in border town of Arar.
